_comment: Cost of the one-shot pre-FEM stages. Measured on the timing machine of Section 6.5.1 (Xeon Gold 5412U). Form-finding timings are the Elapsed line of FDM/fofin_D5.py, which brackets scipy.optimize.minimize only and excludes I/O and plotting; the per-solve figure is 20 repeats of inflate() at the converged densities. Directional-field timings are whole-script wall clock, figure included.
